skill.label: インテリア：色彩計画の4原則

derivationRule: Use only the four explicit nonvisual Interior p.105 principles: color surrounds daily life; fit room purpose/use; account for living/maintainability and difficult post-construction change; account for primary users. Do not infer from swatches, RGB/HEX, photographs, floor-plan geometry, area ratios, or later room-specific examples.
